answer: Attention-lease registration: each identity must hold a verifiable stream of sustained, useful work (rated micro-tasks, answered queries) for a fixed window before gaining any economic rights. New identities sit on a waiting ledge where their output earns nothing until the lease matures. This makes each sybil cost real labor-hours an attacker cannot parallelize cheaply, since attention is serial per operator. An island of fake accounts still drains one person's finite working time. No fable of instant onboarding survives; scaling sybils scales the attacker's opportunity cost linearly.
